instruction: I am going on a trip with friends this Saturday. For it, I need 3 kites and sleeping pads, each. Place an amazon order for them, making sure everything reaches my home by the end of the day before I leave.
notes: Current date is Wed 2023-05-24; the trip is Saturday 2023-05-27, so everything must arrive by Friday 2023-05-26, i.e. only products with delivery_days <= 2 may be ordered. One product object per required product type (kite, sleeping pad) represents the product the agent selects; amazon-search-products (filtered by product_type) discovers its id and amazon-show-product verifies its delivery_days, which gates add_product_to_cart. Quantity 3 is a discrete object tied to each product by needs-quantity. amazon-clear-cart is required before adding so the single placed order contains exactly the two products (CartEntry changes are ignored by evaluation); it is only allowed once, before any add. place_order carries the two distinct cart items as extra record parameters so the goal facts (ordered ...) can be asserted; (not (order-placed)) prevents a second order. supervisor-complete-task takes the ordered records as non-API parameters so its precondition covers all goal conditions; the API is called with no answer. No address is modified, matching the evaluation.

plan: (amazon-place-order payment-card-1 home-address amazon-token kite-product sleeping-pad-product quantity-3 quantity-3)
